professionalSummary.text: Develops failure-prediction models from equipment telemetry for industrial air compressors using vibration and temperature data.
professionalSummary.witness: Machine learning engineer at Halvorsen Compressors from August 2019 to May 2024, building failure-prediction models for industrial air compressors from vibration and temperature telemetry.

professionalSummary.text: Is the registered owner of a production model, approving retraining releases and threshold changes.
professionalSummary.witness: Recorded as model owner for the bearing-failure model in the company's model register from 2021; approved each retraining release (six between 2022 and 2024) and two changes to the alert threshold.

professionalSummary.text: Builds telemetry ingestion and feature pipelines that resample controller data into ten-minute windows and write features to the analytics warehouse with daily completeness checks.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the telemetry ingestion pipeline that resamples controller data into ten-minute windows and writes the features to the analytics warehouse, with a daily completeness check on each controller's feed.

professionalSummary.text: Reviews model alerts with field-service engineers against inspection findings, recording whether site inspections found bearing wear and adjusting the review list when alerts proved false.
